maria_csm: Heads-up: Pinecrest Health flagged for pre-renewal ops. Usage steady but we see a consistent p99 tail spike on long multi-turn chats (~+120ms vs baseline). Thinking a proactive plan: staged quantization + model hop + split routing canary before the renewal call on Wed. Need eng + solutions input.
sam_infra: Can you paste the recent latency buckets and whether traffic is on hosted or dedicated? any PII paths we should avoid changing?
maria_csm: Hosted (prod-us-east), mostly public text generation endpoint /v1/chat. Quick metrics past 24h: p50 62ms, p95 145ms, p99 420ms. Long requests (>1024 tokens) make up ~6% of invocations but 38% of p99 time. No regulated PII flagged but they sometimes send long clinical notes non-PII.
leah_eng: Noted. Proposed safe plan:
1) Canary route: create a split route that sends 5% of traffic to a canary serving int8-quantized variant of their current model for short sequences (<512) and to a smaller 7B quantized model for long sequences.
2) Use prefix KV caching for repeated context to reduce token generation time.
3) Add an automatic fallback: if canary latency p99 > baseline p99 or error rate increases by >0.5%, route back to baseline immediately.
4) Ramp schedule: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 48 hours with manual stop.
Quick routing JSON (for ops use):
```json
{
  "route_name": "pinecrest_pre_renew_canary",
  "rules": [
    {"match": "sequence_length < 512", "weights": {"pinecrest_int8": 0.05, "pinecrest_baseline": 0.95}},
    {"match": "sequence_length >= 512", "weights": {"pinecrest_7b_q": 0.05, "pinecrest_baseline": 0.95}}
  ],
  "fallback": {"on_latency_pct_increase": 5, "on_error_delta": 0.5}
}
```
leah_eng: Expected impact: p99 should drop ~30-50ms for long chats on canary with ~-35% cost/unit for quantized paths. Risk: small LM-7B might produce slightly different phrasing; we should add eval prompts for top customer flows.
ryan_solutions: I'll prepare a 1-slide customer summary + rollback playbook. Need the expected cost delta and a short QA list for their integration team. Also can you provide which eval prompts to use for semantic parity checks?
maria_csm: Cost delta estimate: int8 path ~-28% token compute, 7B-q path ~-45% compute vs current 13B baseline. Semantic parity tests: 12 representative prompts (I’ll drop them in a doc). Can we schedule the canary Thu 10:00am PST? Customer prefers morning.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled by ops-bot: start=1768586400 (Thu 10:00 PST). Will post status updates to this thread. :calendar:
sam_infra: One note: Pinecrest uses customer-managed KMS for private keys on a few enterprise feature flags. Ensure the canary variant does not alter key handling. Also tag the canary routes with tenant_id so RBAC + audit logs remain clean.
leah_eng: Good call — will add route tags: tenant:pinecrest, canary:pre-renew. I'll also add a temporary metric alert: p99_canary > baseline_p99 + 20ms -> auto-fail and revert.
ryan_solutions: Slide deck + QA checklist incoming. I'll include suggested phrasing for the renewal convo focusing on cost savings + safety net (auto-fallback + canary metrics).
maria_csm: Great. Can we do a quick 30m sync now? I can host and share the customer prompts doc. @leah_eng @sam_infra @ryan_solutions :thumbsup:
leah_eng: happy to — joining in 2.
